_comment: The region registry -- one canonical definition per NL Network region. Live 3 regions (gander/avalon/goosebay) are DERIVED from the existing source maps (fb-post.py:REGION_POSTAL, each site's tools/_fleet_config.json, tools/agent_roster.json, community-agent-map.json, live-aggregates.json, region-config/*.yml). The 6 future/peer regions are seeded from public Canada Post / Statistics Canada geography and the peer brokerages' own published service-area claims -- NOT derived from any Turner system where Turner has no presence. No agent rosters, NAP, or listing data is invented for unstaffed regions -- state:'recruiting' regions carry no roster and no domain until a real agent/team is assigned. Operator values: 'turner' (Turner-operated -- includes labrador-city, which is Turner's own recruiting-only labwestrealty.com site with no listings feed), 'peer' (an independently-operating Royal LePage sibling brokerage we backlink to but do not operate, share data with, or share tech with), null (genuinely unclaimed 'recruiting' white space with no operator of any kind yet).

_field_notes.territory: The region key, repeated as a field so consumers reading a single region object never need the parent key -- this is the field name to use everywhere a 'region' concept is threaded through code (payloads, columns, JS globals). Deliberately NOT named region_key: that name is already a load-bearing column on market_stats/market_report_subs with a DIFFERENT meaning (a market-aggregate label like 'Gander and Area', not a territory slug) -- see market_region_keys below for that vocabulary.
_field_notes.site_id: Supabase site_id vocabulary (js/saved-search.js SITE_ID_MAP, vow-funnel-event.ts VALID_SITES). null where the region has no Supabase-backed consumer surface (peer regions, pure-recruiting regions, and labrador-city -- Turner-operated but no listings/saved-search feature there today).
_field_notes.r2_slug: Cloudflare R2 photo-bucket slug (tools/_fleet_config.json:r2_site_slug, agent_territory.py:R2_SLUG). null where the region has no listing photos of its own.
_field_notes.repo_dir: Local folder / GitHub repo name (fleet/manifest.json:sites, agent_territory.py:SITE_DIR, agent_roster.json:home_site). null for peer and pure-recruiting regions -- no Turner-controlled repo exists for them.
_field_notes.office_key: js/turner-network.js OFFICES[].key vocabulary. null where the region is not one of the network-strip offices (peer regions, pure-recruiting regions).
_field_notes.site_key: tools/_fleet_config.json:site_key / fleet/manifest.json site keys ('hub'/'gander'/'avalon'/'goosebay'/'labwest'). null where none applies.
_field_notes.nav_label: Short label for a region strip / nav tab (fleet/canonical/js/nav.js REGIONS[].label uses this vocabulary today, e.g. 'Grand Falls' not the full 'label' text). label stays the long/display form used in page copy and cards.
_field_notes.towns: Human-readable coverage towns/communities, for portal cards and recruiting-page copy. Sourced from CLAUDE.md's Geographic facts section, each site's tools/region-config/*.yml children, and tools/idx-cache/live-aggregates.json region keys where those three agree.
_field_notes.market_region_keys: The subset of tools/idx-cache/live-aggregates.json 'regions' keys (== market_stats.region_key / market_report_subs.region_key) that belong to this territory -- lets a portal market tile join straight to the aggregate without re-deriving the mapping. Only populated for live turner regions (peer/recruiting regions have no Turner-side market aggregate).

A0E.resolution: Route by towns[] match first (each region's town list is authoritative). Mike's decision (2026-09-08): a postal-code-only match with no town match (an A0E FSA lookup that can't be resolved to a specific town) falls to clarenville as the tiebreak -- flagged, not silent, wherever this fires (log the fallback; the town lists should be refined over time to shrink how often this path is hit).

Corrected 2026-09-08 (fleet review): domain/repo_dir/site_key/office_key were all null/missing in schema v1 even though the site has been live since before this registry existed -- state stays 'recruiting' (no listings feed, no roster) but operator is 'turner', not null.
